project: Amazon Forensic Analytics - Digital Evidence Integrity & Fraud Detection

output_case_schema.investigation_priority: enum: Routine review | Contextual examination | High-priority examination
output_case_schema.cooccurrence_likelihood: enum: Very strong | Strong | Moderate | Weak
output_case_schema.forensic_verdict: enum: Content authenticity concern | Coordinated negative campaign pattern | Reviewer fraud pattern | Authentic complaint likely | Routine complaint

artifacts.text_similarity_model.joblib: dict: vectorizer, neighbors, sample_size, similarity_threshold, random_state
artifacts.reviewer_anomaly_model.joblib: dict: scaler, isolation_forest, feature_columns, anomaly_percentile_threshold, random_state
artifacts.scoring_rules.json: component weights, priority bins, likelihood bands, domains, verdict rules, customer guidance
artifacts.forensic_verdicts.csv: top priority cases with scores, likelihoods, verdicts, guidance
artifacts.forensic_case_register.csv: full case register with all signals and interpretations
artifacts.priority_case_narratives.csv: narrative reasoning chains for priority cases
artifacts.reviewer_features.csv: reviewer behavior, network, and anomaly table
